cards.title: Before the crash
cards.text: EIA Cushing WTI spot opened 2020 at $63.27/b (RWTCD). This line is the official spot series pinned from eia.gov, not a model forecast and not the hashed futures settlement.

cards.title: Demand collapse
cards.text: Spot printed $31.05 on 9 Mar 2020 as COVID travel restrictions crushed petroleum demand. EIA later wrote that U.S. weekly refinery inputs then fell 20% (Today in Energy, 5 Jan 2021).

cards.title: Cushing 76% full
cards.text: Spot still positive at $18.31. EIA: Cushing stocks 60 million barrels, 76% of working capacity. Hashed cells Physical Balance & Carry!D14=60.0 and D18=0.76 come from that same article.

cards.title: The negative print
cards.text: This series: -$36.98 Cushing spot. Hashed Hedging!C7 is the May futures settlement -$37.63. EIA also recorded an intraday low of -$40.32. Three public numbers, one day.

cards.title: Back near $40
cards.text: EIA: WTI climbed to $40/b on 1 Jul 2020. This series: $39.88. The hashed case records 40.0 from that article. Frozen history, not a trade or a live hedge.
